title: The carrier is H^n-null inside a relatively compact open set on which the current vanishes
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set and W ⊆ ℝ^P. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be a GeometricCurrentOn U n, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) representing T: T(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) = TestFormOn U n. Assume W is open, closure W is compact, closure W ⊆ U, and T vanishes on W, i.e. T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Then H^n(M ∩ W) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → μHE[n] (R.carrier ∩ W) = 0
